description: This file defines the NumberIsTooLargeException class, a custom exception used within the Apache Commons Math library to indicate that a number exceeds a specified maximum. It extends MathIllegalNumberException and provides constructors to include context-specific information about the violation.

classes.name: NumberIsTooLargeException
classes.description: A specific exception class indicating that a number is larger than a specified maximum, with additional information about the maximum and whether the maximum is inclusive.

methods.name: NumberIsTooLargeException
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a specific localization pattern, the wrong value, the maximum, and whether the bound is allowed.

methods.name: getBoundIsAllowed
methods.description: Returns whether the maximum value is included in the allowed range.
